title: Linearity of Fourier coefficients
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set with probability mass function $\pi$, and let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis on $(\Omega,\pi)$ indexed by a finite nonempty set $\iota$. For a finite set $\kappa$, a natural number $n$, a family of real-valued functions $f_j$ on $\Omega^n$ indexed by $j\in\kappa$, and a multi-index $a\in\iota^n$, the Fourier coefficient of their pointwise sum is the sum of their Fourier coefficients: $\widehat{\sum_{j\in\kappa} f_j}(a)=\sum_{j\in\kappa}\widehat{f_j}(a)$.
